description: scriptconv's identity/passthrough backend (Phonemizer.UNICODE): returns the input word unchanged, no phonemization occurs. Not a real G2P engine - registered as the arena's own worst-case identity baseline for the g2p league, same role a majority/random baseline plays elsewhere. Verified with get_ipa('hello','en-US')=='hello' and get_ipa('mundo','pt-PT')=='mundo' - exact passthrough, confirmed on 3 words per language.
notes: Verified working (trivially) for en-US and pt-PT in the shared venv (~/.venvs/ovos, ovos-scriptconv-g2p-plugin 0.0.1a1, scriptconv installed). No package extra required. Not eligible as a gold/reference source under the repo's provenance-tier convention - it performs no phonemization at all.
